# The per-window catalogue of the ALMA 40 pc technosignature search: one row per searched spectral window.
# Accompanies the arXiv submission as an ancillary file (anc/).  Tab-separated; an empty field is a value that does not apply.
# A window is identified by its star, its execution block and its frequency limits.
# The crossing flag is the adopted one: 54 of these 1663 windows hold an adopted primary threshold crossing.  The crossing ledger holds 56, the other 2 lying in archival-tail execution blocks outside this catalogue.
#
# Columns:
#   1  star               star name, as in the paper
#   2  system             system identifier; components of one system share it
#   3  eb                 ALMA execution block (asdm) identifier
#   4  band               ALMA receiver band
#   5  nu_lo_GHz          lower edge of the spectral window, GHz
#   6  nu_hi_GHz          upper edge of the spectral window, GHz
#   7  chan_width_Hz      delivered channel width, Hz
#   8  on_source_s        on-source integration time at this position, s
#   9  rms_mJy            per-channel noise at the extraction position, mJy
#  10  smin_mJy           amplitude limit at the trigger, mJy
#  11  drift_max_Hz_s     largest drift rate searched in this window, Hz/s
#  12  a_max_m_s2         line-of-sight acceleration that corresponds to it, m/s^2
#  13  eirp_p90_W         adopted 90 per cent completeness EIRP limit, W
#  14  eirp_p90_lo_W      lower end of its interval, W
#  15  eirp_p90_hi_W      upper end of its interval, W
#  16  dist_pc            distance adopted for the star, pc
#  17  search_class       A where the window resolves a carrier, B where it is coarse
#  18  crossing           1 where this window holds an adopted primary threshold crossing
#  19  disposition        the disposition printed in the crossing ledger, where there is one
#
